name: Anahit Pogosova
title: Cloud Architecture & Engineering Lead
bio: Anahit is an AWS Data Hero and Cloud Architecture & Engineering Lead at F-Secure, where she leads the Cloud Center of Excellence: a team focused on AWS governance, security, and cloud best practices. With over 16 years of experience across full-stack and data engineering, her career has evolved from building monolithic on-premises systems to architecting modern, resilient, and scalable cloud solutions. Anahit speaks at conferences and meetups, appears on podcasts and YouTube channels, and teaches online courses.
